items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: one of the great tenor players, Cecil Irvin was his name, he was killed

ctx.x: Yes. Then they became an automobile company and his father worked for the covered wagon to the automobile company with them. Bud got to learn to play music and came to Chicago and got into Earl Hines band after that big accident that Earl Hines band had when Cecil Irvin got killed and Barry Franklin got hurt.
I don‟t remember that, what happened with that?
